text:
ajay: Heads-up — planned cutover tonight 23:00 PT for API v2 -> runtime v3 kernel change + router weight shift. Change window 23:00-00:30 PT. Need dependency owner ack. TL;DR: API contract bump (v2.1), runtime kernel switch (int8->q4), router gradual weight migration. Will pin model-service to 3.4.2 during rollout. @maria please confirm release notes posted. @tom runtime ops: confirm KV/eviction thresholds and rollback toggle.

maria: Posted release notes here: https://redwood.internal/release/2187654321 — includes compatibility notes and upgrade checklist. :white_check_mark:


tom: Runtime + infra checked. Kernel change requires quantization-fallback flag. I'll add emergency revert toggle at /runtime/flags/quant-fallback. Also increasing kv-cache TTL to reduce cold-miss spike during canary.


sara: Console: minimal UI change flagged, behind feature flag console.ui.api-v2.1, will keep disabled for canary. Dashboards updated (gen-traffic, errors, latency).


liz: Router plan: shift weights 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over ~10m. Health checks running; pause condition: 5xx or 429 delta >0.5% vs baseline for 5m. Assigning @ops-bot to enforce auto-pause.


deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled deploy 2024-06-18T06:00Z job=release/cutover-2187654321 env=prod window=90m

ajay: Rollback criteria: if p95 latency > +150ms over baseline for 5m OR error rate >0.5% OR sustained GPU/CPU >80% for 5m. Rollback owners: tom (runtime kernel), liz (router traffic), ajay (API). Follow runbook if triggered.


tom: I'll instrument a temporary trace flag kv_warmup=true during the window. Quick rollback snippet I'm keeping handy:

```
# rollback runtime to previous image
kubectl -n runtime set image deployment/runtime runtime=image:runtime-3.4.1
curl -XPOST https://ops.internal/agents/reload
```

liz: Router pause command (kept in runbook):

```
opsctl router shift --service api --set-weight=0 --reason "rollback"
```

sara: Console will remain off for canary. If we need to expose degraded states to support, ping me to flip the flag.

ops-bot: ops-bot: monitors configured — latency-p95, error-rate, gpu-util. Alerts to #eng-oncall. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cutover-2187654321

ajay: @maria release notes include rollback steps and oncall contacts?

maria: Yes — step-by-step rollback, contact list, and A/B test dataset link + eval metrics included.


tom: Ready on runtime side, will be monitoring and on standby for rollback. :heavy_check_mark:

liz: Router owner ack. I'll watch metrics and initiate pause if thresholds are hit.

ajay: Final: starting staged rollout at 23:00 PT. Logging start in this thread; will post major milestones. :rocket:


deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started at 2187655000 status=canary-5% job=release/cutover-2187654321


deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout progressed to 25% at 2187655200


deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout progressed to 50% at 2187655800


deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout completed to 100% at 2187656300 status=success

ajay: Observed stable after cutover — p95 within baseline, error-rate ~0.08%. Closing window and unpinning model-service 3.4.2. Huge thanks to the team for quick responses. :tada:
